name: ai-fill-regular-steps
description: Roadmap 153500: the steps of the long fill of ai-fill-long-gap (the same scene, physics off), and today's half step as the known result. This fixture passes while the shipped model fails the measure, so the gate stays usable; when a model passes, regular flips to true and short to []. The rule (crates/ac-core/src/steps.rs, hand-worked in its tests): contacts landing inside the span in order, a foot replanted within 0.10 m being one contact, each step signed along the root's travel, the feet taking turns and no step of a walking root under half the median. Hand-worked by y from the last run's contacts, not yet run with this rule, hence the tolerance 0.01: the right foot's two contacts (y 0.015, 0.0189) join, then L -0.4177, R -0.9178, L -0.9036, R -1.3534, L -1.9899. Steps 0.4327, 0.5, -0.0142, 0.45, 0.6365; median 0.45, half of it 0.225: step 2 alone is short, and the feet alternate. The lengths themselves are along the root's travel, not exactly y, so they are not checked here.
